issues.details: "Bulma" search returned 8 results but domain did not appear - brand may be too generic or not indexed
issues.name: Brand name discoverability
issues.recommendation: Make sure a clean search for your brand name returns your own domain in the top results. If it does not, your brand may be too generic, conflict with a more established term, or not yet indexed. Strengthen brand-name search by claiming consistent NAP across listings, earning press mentions that link to the canonical domain, and avoiding redirect chains that mask the apex domain in search results.
